data.name: Jefferey
data.gender_notes: Jefferey is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jefferey is recorded in name-lists as “God's peaceful leader”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jefferey expresses “God's peaceful leader”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jefferey total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: יִפְרֵיהִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Yipareyah, derived from Hebrew Yiphar (addition, increase), and Reyah (shepherd). Meaning 'God has added a shepherd'.

in_greek.name: Ιεφραιμ
in_greek.meaning: God will see, he will add
in_greek.long_meaning: Iefraim, derived from Hebrew Yiphar (addition, increase) and Raamah (exalted, high). Meaning 'God will see and add (a child to the family)'.

in_latin.name: Iefraemus
in_latin.meaning: God will see, he will add
in_latin.long_meaning: Iefraemus, derived from Hebrew Yiphar (addition, increase) and Raamah (exalted, high). Meaning 'God will see and add (a child to the family)'.
